title: Last seeing Joe Benjamin at a Pennsylvania festival
summary: At a late 1960s jazz festival with Troup, Collins unexpectedly met Joe Benjamin playing with Clark Terry and saw Earl Hines and Budd Johnson.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Yes. And listened to music together a lot

That's right, that's right. We were dear friends. In later years I -- the last time I saw Joe as a matter of fact, I did a jazz -- let's see, one of these jazz festivals where in Pennsylvania, and with Bobby Troop. And it was a real pleasant surprise seeing Joe because I had no idea that he was going to be there, and I'm trying to think who was he playing with. Oh, he was playing with Clark Terry's band. And -- He played with Clark Terry before he joined Duke.

Yeah, he was playing with Clark Terry's band -- Grady Tate and Earl Hines was on the bill with the great Buddy Johnson, soloist. And Bobby Troop was on the -- this bill. Bobby is from Pennsylvania, incidently, he's from Lancaster, Pennsylvania. And we had all of the local -- he's the hero, you know, there. But -- That must have been the late '60s.

Yeah, yeah. At this time I took a leave of absence from this show that I was doing with Terry Gibbs, this operation entertainment, to do this thing with Bobby.
